description: Get full details for a single place by its OpenTripMap xid (obtained from opentripmap_places_radius or opentripmap_autosuggest). Returns name, address, categories, Wikidata/Wikipedia links, description extract, image, and website. Example: opentripmap_place_detail({ xid: "N123456", _apiKey: "your-key" })
name: opentripmap_place_detail
title: Opentripmap Place Detail
